Taste ye (Qal)
Bless ye (Pi.)
He will serve (Pi.)
Cry thou (f. Qal)
And they fought (Niph.)
He will cleanse (Pi.)
I will wash (Qal)
Thou (f.) hast been washed (Pu.)
I will wash (Qal) thee (f.: see § 31. 3 (a) i)

parse.gloss: I will wash thee (f.: see § 31. 3 (a) i)

items.answer: Let us choose (1 pl. cohortat. Qal)
Crying aloud (Pi. ptc. m.)
My lord (בַּעַל with 1 s. suffix); as a form it might also be 2 s. f. imper. Qal of בָּעַל
Thy (f.) gates

items.prompt: יֻקַּח־נָא מְעַט מַיִם וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשָּׁעֲנוּ תַּחַת הָעֵץ וְאֶקְחָה פַת־לֶחֶם וְסַעֲדוּ לִבְּכֶם אַחַר תַּעֲבֹרוּ
items.answer: Let there now be fetched a little water, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree, and let me fetch a morsel of bread, and sustain ye your hearts: afterwards ye shall pass on.

items.prompt: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יהוה אֶת־הָאָדָם וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ מִגַּן־עֵדֶן לַעֲבֹד אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח מִשָּׁם
items.answer: And Yahweh drove out the man and sent him forth from the garden of Eden to till the ground whence he had been taken.

items.prompt: הָכְרַת מִנְחָה וָנֶסֶךְ אָבְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְשָׁרְתֵי יהוה
items.answer: The meal-offering and the drink-offering are cut off; the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, mourn.

items.prompt: וַיְבָרְכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יְבָרֶכְךָ יהוה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ יִשָּׂא יהוה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ
items.answer: And the priests blessed the Israelites, saying, Yahweh bless thee and keep thee, Yahweh lift up his face towards thee.

items.prompt: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יהוה לֵאמֹר עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים
items.answer: And the Israelites cried to Yahweh, saying, We have forsaken our God and served the Baals.

items.prompt: וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וַאֲבָרְכָה מְבָרְכֶיךָ וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כֹּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer: And I will bless thee and make thy name great, and I will bless those that bless thee, and by thee shall all the families of the earth bless themselves.
Bless Yahweh, O my soul, and forget not any of his kindnesses.

items.prompt: ביום ההוא תאמרי לי אישי ולא תקראי לי עוד בעלי
items.answer: In that day thou shalt say to me, My husband, and thou shalt no more call me, My lord.

data.pointed: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תֹּאמְרִי לִי אִישִׁי וְלֹא־תִקְרְאִי לִי עוֹד בַּעְלִי

items.answer: בְּעֵבֶר נַהֲרֵי כוּשׁ

items.prompt: Our feet shall stand in thy (f.) gates (O) Jerusalem.
items.answer: תַּעֲמֹדְנָה רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלָםִ

items.prompt: Thou shalt love Yahweh thy God and him thou shalt serve.
items.answer: תֶּאֱהַב אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד

items.prompt: And your fathers cried unto me and said, We shall perish from the violence of our enemies.
items.answer: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֵלַי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ נֹאבַד מֵחֲמַס אֹיְבֵינוּ

items.prompt: And she said unto her husband, Drive out this maid-servant and her son.
items.answer: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ גָּרֵשׁ אֶת־הַשִּׁפְחָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ

items.prompt: And they forgot Yahweh, and he sold them into the hand of their enemies and they fought against them.
items.answer: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָם

items.prompt: And they took wives from all whom they chose.
items.answer: וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ
